newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-GINOLA'S MOVE TO TOTTENHAM VIRTUALLY SEALED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GINOLA'S MOVE TO TOTTENHAM VIRTUALLY SEALED.

text.p: French winger David Ginola is set to join Tottenham from Newcastle after agreeing personal terms with the English Premier League club'an Alan Sugar.
The London club's Clubcall line said on Monday that a deal was "all but done".
There was no other official comment from either the North London club or from Newcastle.

The Clubcall line said the transfer was expected to be for around 2.6 million pounds ($4.4 million) and the 30-year-old Frenchman was expected to sign shortly before joining the squad on their tour of Norway this week.
The clubcall service quoted Ginola's agent Michel Benguigui as saying that the player had met Sugar on Sunday in the south of France and they had agreed personal terms for the move.
"The two clubs need to finalise a fee but David will have a medical on Tuesday and should link up with the other Tottenham players on their pre-season tour of Norway on Wednesday," Benguigui said.

Ginola, who joined Newcastle from Paris St Germain two years ago, has been unable to hold down a steady first team place at the club since Kenny Dalglish took over as manager from Kevin Keegan last season.
The winger will fill the gap left at Tottenham after the shock departure last month of England striker Teddy Sheringham to Manchester United.
